# Columns: mp_paidads.ods_log_translog_event_hi__reg_s0_live

*Auto-generated by ads-kb-datamap (from-code) on 2026-06-15*

## Column Usage Notes

### 非累加字段 (Non-Additive Fields)

该表为事件明细级 ODS 表，通常不直接聚合。但在 JOIN 到 translog_tab 后构造 DWD 时，需注意：
- 跨 `cpm_event_details_str` 展开时，同一 `deduct_unique_id` 会产生多行，cost 需通过 `imp_cost_detail.adjusted_cost` 分摊

### 枚举值映射 (Value Mappings)

| Column | Value | Meaning |
|--------|-------|---------|
| translog.operation | 1 | CPC deduction (click) |
| translog.operation | 11 | CPM deduction (impression) |
| translog.operation | 15 | CPS deduction (order) |
| placement | 0, 4, 4400 | keyword (search) |
| placement | 1, 2, 5, 8, 801, 802, 805, 4401, 4402, 4405 | targeting (discovery) |
| placement | 3, 7, 20, 2003, 2030, 46 | shop ads |
| placement | 9 | display |
| placement | 40, 50 | ROI2 |
| placement | 45 | shop CPM |
| placement | 54 | video |
| placement | 65 | banner |
| placement | 1000, 1001, 1002, 1005, 1200, 1201, 1202, 1205 | boost |
| placement | 3327, 3328, 3337, 3338, 3339, 3342, 3348 | livestream |

### 常见 WHERE 值 (Common Filter Values)

- `grass_region`: 'ID', 'MY', 'SG', 'TH', 'VN', 'PH', 'TW', 'BR', 'MX', 'CO', 'CL', 'AR'
- `translog.operation`: IN (1, 11, 15) -- 限制为扣费操作（click/imp/order）
- `grass_date`: 通常查 2 天范围 `>= DATE('${grass_date}') AND <= DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), 1)` -- 因为事件可能跨日
- `translog.timestamp`: 用 timezone 转换限制为当日事件（FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP / TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP 处理时区）

### 关键数据结构 (Key Data Structures)

**translog 结构体** (顶层嵌套 struct):
- `translog.id`, `translog.adsid`, `translog.itemid`, `translog.shopid`
- `translog.timestamp`, `translog.operation`, `translog.status`
- `translog.price`, `translog.placement`, `translog.keyword`
- `translog.deduct_unique_id`, `translog.userid`
- `translog.acc_before_balance`, `translog.acc_after_balance`
- `translog.dai_before_balance`, `translog.dai_after_balance`
- `translog.extinfo` (binary, 需 UDF 解码: `TranslogExtinfoDecodeUDF`)
- `translog.acc_user_id`, `translog.account_id`
- `translog.deviceid`, `translog.client_ip`

**decoded_extinfo** (from `json_from_protobuf(extinfo)`):
- `$.campaignid` (bigint) -- campaign ID
- `$.entrance` (int) -- 入口
- `$.pricingType` (int) -- 定价类型
- `$.matchType` (int) -- 匹配类型
- `$.recallType` (int) -- 召回类型
- `$.bidType` (string) -- 出价类型
- `$.requestId` (string) -- 请求 ID
- `$.entryPoint` (string) -- 入口点
- `$.expectDeductPrice` (bigint) -- 期望扣费金额
- `$.deductionInfo.bidprice` (bigint) -- 出价
- `$.deductionInfo.nextScore` (double) -- 第二名 eCPM
- `$.deductionInfo.nextAdsid` (bigint) -- 第二名 ads_id
- `$.deductionInfo.algoName` (string) -- AB sign
- `$.deductionInfo.quality` (double) -- pCTR
- `$.deductionInfo.deductionPrice` (bigint) -- 扣费价格
- `$.query.keyword` (string) -- 用户搜索词
- `$.query.sorttype` (int) -- 排序类型
- `$.query.itemid` (bigint) -- PDP item ID
- `$.query.shopid` (bigint) -- PDP shop ID
- `$.topupSign` (string) -- 充值标识
- `$.adsCredits` (JSON array) -- 广告信用详情
- `$.paidFreeExpirySummary` (JSON) -- 付费/免费信用到期汇总
- `$.deductTimestamp` (bigint) -- 扣费时间戳
- `$.clickTimestamp` (bigint) -- 点击时间戳
- `$.targetAffiliateUserId` (bigint) -- 联盟用户 ID
- `$.lsSessionId` (bigint) -- 直播 session ID
- `$.batchCnt` (bigint) -- CPM 批量计数
- `$.trafficSource` (int) -- 流量来源
- `$.voucherDeductionPrice` (bigint) -- 券扣费
- `$.buyerSegments` (array<binary>) -- 买家分群（需 BuyerSegementDecodeUDF 解码）
- `$.shopTraceInfo.clickArea` (int) -- 点击区域

**cpm_event_details_str** (JSON array, 展开为 cpm_detail):
- `user_id` (bigint)
- `entrance` (int)
- `platform` (int)
- `page_type` (string)
- `page_section` (string)
- `target_type` (string)
- `sub_entrance` (int)
- `is_ocpm` (boolean)
- `app_version` (string)
- `shop_recall_type` (bigint)
- `vvid` (string)
- `ctx_item_type` (int)
- `ls_session_id` (bigint)
- `item_json_data`, `shop_json_data`, `banner_json_data`, `video_json_data`, `live_json_data`, `algo_json_data` (string JSON)

**imp_cost_details** (array<struct>):
- `adjusted_cost` (bigint) -- 调整后的 CPM 扣费
- `credit_cost` (bigint) -- 信用扣费
- `balance_cost` (bigint) -- 余额扣费
- `unique_id` (string) -- 唯一标识

**livestream_props** (struct, placement IN (40,50)):
- `ls_session_id` (bigint)
- `streamer_id` (bigint)
